race.comment: SOMETHINGINTHEAIR (2) looks to have found the perfect race to break through. Showed the benefit of the first-up run when beaten just under a length two back, then got even closer last time out. Better for the run at 1600m and looks primed to go fourth up. Does have a wide gate, but that's offset by having the services of Blake Shinn, who will be an asset to anything he rides here at his old home track. TERRACOTTA WARRIOR (6) was well fancied when resuming last start over 1462m at this track when fourth, beaten 6 lengths. Plain that day, but better for it and suited up in trip. VANARA PRINCESS (11) finished 4 lengths away in sixth last time out over 1400m at Warrnambool but rises in distance today and gets blinkers. STYLE GUIDE (10) finished sixth two runs back then improved last start but found a couple better over 1590m at Wangaratta when beaten less than a length. Inside draw a plus. WELKIN STAR (3) was only a length off SOMETHINGINTHEAIR last start, so warrants respect.
